# hush_github_app_access_privilege (Resource)

Manage GitHub App access privileges in the Hush Security platform: the repositories and permissions installation tokens are narrowed to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Narrow tokens to read access on two repositories
resource "hush_github_app_access_privilege" "example" {
  name         = "read-app-repos"
  description  = "Read the app repositories"
  repositories = ["frontend", "backend"]
  permissions = {
    contents = "read"
    metadata = "read"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the GitHub App access privilege
- `permissions` (Map of String) The GitHub App permissions tokens are narrowed to, as a non-empty map of permission name to level (`read`, `write` or `admin`), e.g. `{ contents = "read" }`. Each must be granted to the App's installation

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the GitHub App access privilege
- `repositories` (List of String) The repositories tokens are narrowed to, by bare name (`my-repo`, not `owner/my-repo`): each 1-100 letters, digits, `.`, `-` or `_`, not `.` or `..`, listed once, at most 500. Empty means every repository the installation can access

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the GitHub App access privilege
- `type` (String) The type of access privilege
